summary: Re-ran the full Flutter, web and backend suites plus Flutter analysis on the current repository tip after reviewing five incoming commits by egkurilov. All automated suites pass. This does not close live two-account roster/privacy, deployed webhook, populated receiver statistics or physical macOS/Windows/Android media acceptance.

reviewed_commits.subject: feat(voice): improve realtime rosters and screen sharing across clients
reviewed_commits.assessment: Large cross-client voice-roster/SSE, ACL revalidation, thumbnail, viewer lifecycle and screen publishing change. Focused and full client/backend regression suites pass; live webhook delivery and two-account privacy acceptance remain open.

reviewed_commits.subject: fix(voice): show connected member avatars and prepare Android release
reviewed_commits.assessment: Android version/release workflow and connected voice-member navigation presentation with focused coverage. No generated release binary was added.

reviewed_commits.subject: fix(ci): exclude standalone macOS integration host from root analysis
reviewed_commits.assessment: Limits root Flutter analysis to the application while the standalone macOS integration host keeps its independent dependency context; analyzer passes.

reviewed_commits.subject: docs(evidence): record web and Android release audit with iOS gap
reviewed_commits.assessment: QA evidence only; records platform/release scope and iOS limitation.

reviewed_commits.subject: feat(screen): show ten-second receiver packet loss percentage
reviewed_commits.assessment: Adds bounded rolling receiver loss calculation in Flutter and web with focused unit/widget coverage; full suites pass. Real populated remote-stream behavior remains unverified.
